answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the signal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The whisper holds work receipts rather than names, so the canyon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
